_documentation.purpose: Settings schema and category/section metadata owned by boost.
_documentation.consumer: extension/settings/controllers/ZentralSettingsCatalog.js reads schema/settings; Runtime filters availability, UI controllers render controls.

schema.label: Free memory once after startup, when the browser has been quiet for 90 seconds
Unloading may include pinned and Essential tabs
schema.description: Off by default: they restore on demand like any tab, but they are your shortlist. Turn this on to let a deep pass include them.

schema.label: Keyboard shortcut for Free memory (light)
schema.description: For example Accel+Shift+B. Empty means no shortcut.
